findings.summary: Motion continues when reduction is requested
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, eight animations continued running with 2000 ms duration and infinite iterations; no reduced-motion CSS rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce branch that disables infinite/non-essential animations and auto-advance.

findings.summary: Page changes are abrupt
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no View Transition rules; navigation between the home, categories, signup, and detail pages is an abrupt document swap.
findings.suggestedFix: Use cross-document View Transitions for same-origin navigation, with reduced-motion fallback.

findings.summary: Persistent chrome does not react to scroll
findings.evidence: The multi-row header and promotional chrome remain static and consume the same vertical space; no @container scroll-state or scroll timeline rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Collapse or soften nonessential header/promotion chrome with scroll-state-aware CSS.

findings.summary: Load-time interruptions obscure the core content
findings.evidence: A large cookie interstitial obscures the central content on load while separate age-verification and sale banners stack above it.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer nonessential promotion, consolidate consent/age steps, and keep a clear, immediately usable dismiss/reject path.

findings.summary: The cookie modal is not exposed as a dialog
findings.evidence: The visually modal cookie layer on the home page has no dialog element or role=dialog; the probe found zero dialog/popover/details primitives.
findings.suggestedFix: Implement it with <dialog> or role=dialog, aria-modal, labelled title, focus containment, Escape policy, and focus restoration.

findings.summary: First-viewport chrome overwhelms content
findings.evidence: Header rows, age-verification, a sale strip, sidebar navigation, upsells, and the cookie modal dominate the first viewport before the core listing.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove or collapse redundant nav, sale, sidebar, and upsell surfaces so the primary listing leads.

findings.summary: Narrow viewports render a clipped 1024 px layout
findings.evidence: At a 360x800 emulated viewport, layout reported scrollWidth 1024 and horizontalOverflowPx 664 on both home and categories; the screenshot shows a clipped desktop layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix viewport/device adaptation, replace fixed widths with intrinsic fluid layout, and verify scrollWidth equals innerWidth at 360 px.

findings.summary: Reusable components do not adapt to their container
findings.evidence: CSS inspection found no @container rules while the reusable navigation and video cards remain laid out for a 1024 px canvas under the narrow primitive condition.
findings.suggestedFix: Add container-type and @container rules for cards/navigation reused in narrow regions.

findings.summary: Keyboard focus is invisible on key controls
findings.evidence: Programmatically focused search, login, navigation, and age-verification controls computed outline-style none and no focus box-shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a high-contrast :focus-visible outline for links, buttons, and form fields; do not remove it without a replacement.

findings.summary: The watch journey is blocked by stacked modal gates
findings.evidence: The representative watch path opens with cookie and age-verification layers over the player, preventing playback until multiple interruptions are handled.
findings.suggestedFix: Sequence consent and legally required age verification as one clear, semantic flow before revealing the player.

findings.summary: Mobile LCP is slow
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 4.3 s and FCP 3.4 s, outside the good LCP range, despite CLS 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset/content, reduce render-blocking work, and defer noncritical scripts to bring LCP below 2.5 s.

findings.summary: Critical delivery is request-heavy
findings.evidence: HAR recorded 143 requests and 1.70 MB transferred, including 11 stylesheets, 61 scripts, and parser-inserted VeryHigh-priority stylesheets.
findings.suggestedFix: Inline/minimize critical CSS, defer noncritical styles/scripts, and shorten parser-blocking dependency chains.

findings.summary: JavaScript dominates the initial payload
findings.evidence: Scripts accounted for 1.02 MB across 61 requests; the 402 KB index bundle and multiple locale/start bundles dominate the load.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split page-specific and locale bundles and load identity/affiliate code only on demand.

findings.summary: Forms, modal, and imagery lack accessible semantics
findings.evidence: Signup email fields have no labels, the home modal has no dialog semantics, and the image audit found one missing alt attribute.
findings.suggestedFix: Add persistent labels, semantic dialog markup, and meaningful/empty alt as appropriate.

findings.summary: Important text fails contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found repeated WCAG contrast failures, including 2.15:1 and 1.75:1 text on the age banner and 3.29:1 view counts.
findings.suggestedFix: Raise age-banner, metadata, badge, and subscribe-button contrast to WCAG AA ratios.

findings.summary: Keyboard users cannot track focus
findings.evidence: The H1/H2 order is simple, but focused buttons and key controls computed outline-style none, leaving keyboard location invisible.
findings.suggestedFix: Define consistent :focus-visible styling and test a full Tab walk in visual order.

findings.summary: Zoom and narrow reflow require horizontal panning
findings.evidence: The 360 px condition does not reflow and overflows by 664 px, so narrow/zoomed use requires horizontal panning.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the 1024 px layout floor and verify WCAG reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom.

findings.summary: Image sizing and delivery are unsound
findings.evidence: Although doctype/UTF-8 are valid, 29 of 36 images lack dimensions and 12 are more than twice their display size.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve intrinsic image space and request responsive assets close to rendered dimensions.

findings.summary: The page is not mobile-friendly under the audit condition
findings.evidence: Links are real hrefs and robots allows the entry page, but the 360 px raw-CDP condition retains a 1024 px layout with 664 px overflow.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct responsive delivery so crawler/mobile rendering sees a reflowed layout rather than clipped desktop content.

findings.summary: Localized indexing signals are incomplete
findings.evidence: The home has a canonical and returns 200, but /sitemap.xml returns 404 and no hreflang links advertise the many visible localized variants.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish a sitemap and reciprocal hreflang links for localized hosts while preserving canonicals and robots consistency.

findings.summary: Transport protections and cookie flags are incomplete
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/frame protection are present, but CSP is only frame-ancestors, nosniff and Referrer-Policy are missing, and two cookies are not Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a full nonce/hash CSP, nosniff, strict Referrer-Policy, and Secure on every HTTPS cookie.

findings.summary: Initial third-party data exposure is excessive
findings.evidence: The load contacted 14 third-party origins; 116 third-party requests transferred 1.58 MB, including collector and ad/affiliate endpoints.
findings.suggestedFix: Gate optional identity, collector, affiliate, and ad calls behind consent/context and minimize transmitted identifiers.

findings.summary: Signup exposes password authentication without a passkey path
findings.evidence: No permission prompt appeared on load, but signup offers social identity or email/password and no passkey/WebAuthn registration path was exposed.
findings.suggestedFix: Add passkey registration/authentication alongside recovery-capable alternatives.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced defensive policies are weak
findings.evidence: CSP lacks script-src/Trusted Types protections, Referrer-Policy and nosniff are missing, and the settings cookie is SameSite=None without Secure.
findings.suggestedFix: Expand CSP/Trusted Types where applicable and tighten Referrer, Permissions, cookie, and MIME policies.

findings.summary: German content uses non-localized number abbreviations
findings.evidence: Visible view counts use English-style abbreviations such as 971.4K and 1.6M in a German interface instead of locale-aware formatting.
findings.suggestedFix: Format counts with Intl.NumberFormat for the active locale and use localized compact notation.

findings.summary: Signup disables autofill and omits labels
findings.evidence: Signup email inputs have autocomplete=off, no associated label, and are not marked required; only the password has new-password autocomplete.
findings.suggestedFix: Use type=email, autocomplete=email/new-password, persistent labels, required, and accessible error associations.

findings.summary: Images waste bytes and omit loading safeguards
findings.evidence: Image evidence found 12 oversized assets, 16 legacy-format assets, 29 missing dimensions, and 8 below-fold images without lazy loading.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive modern formats, reserve dimensions, and lazy-load genuinely below-fold images.

findings.summary: Initial loading performs avoidable work
findings.evidence: The entry load performs 143 requests, including 61 scripts and 116 third-party requests, before the user engages with the content.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer page-irrelevant bundles and background/affiliate fetches until user intent or idle budget.

findings.summary: Third-party bytes dominate the page budget
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 1.58 MB of 1.70 MB transferred, including a 1.08 MB static CDN origin and Google identity on initial load.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget, self-host/trim essential assets, and delay optional Google/affiliate resources.
